column1: # Source-level license metadata for remote skills whose installed skill folders
# omit the upstream repository LICENSE file.
# The audit uses this only for sourceType=github skills without a local
# LICENSE*/COPYING* file. Prefer local license files when available.
# Existing sources are kept explicit so future no-license remote additions do
# not silently become public-split-safe without review.
